verification_candidates.claim_text: Some people are allergic to ingredients in the vaccine and therefore cannot get vaccinated.

verification_candidates.rationale: Whether vaccine ingredients commonly cause allergic contraindications is checkable and affects exemption policy.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Some required vaccines must be repeated every 10 years for certain jobs.

verification_candidates.rationale: Booster intervals for occupational vaccines are checkable.
